root.name: Vienna Game: Heyde Variation
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 d5 4. fxe5 Nxe4 5. Qf3 f5 6. d4

overview: White answers the Vienna Gambit line 4.fxe5 Nxe4 with 5.Qf3 f5 6.d4, building a big centre and aiming at the e4-knight and the f5/d5 pawns. Black keeps the extra central tension with ...Nc6 or ...Qe7 and ...Bb4 ideas and tries to hold the e4-knight. The game is sharp and tactical with queen and knight tricks on the e-file and d5 square.

white_ideas.idea: Support e5 with d4 and hit the e4-knight with Bd3 or Nxe4 at the right moment
Use the f-file and the queen on f3 against f5 and the black king

black_ideas.idea: Meet 6.d4 with ...Nc6 and ...Be7 or ...Bb4 to pressure e5 and d4
Keep the e4-knight supported with ...f5 and ...d5, and castle quickly

typical_structures.structure: White pawns e5/d4 against Black pawns d5/f5, with Black knight on e4
Locked centre with piece play around e4 and e5

character.notes: Early queen on f3, a knight on e4 and pawns on e5/f5/d5 give forcing tactics where a slip loses a piece.

gambit.notes: After 4.fxe5 Nxe4 the pawns are level (f-pawn for e-pawn); nothing is given up at the root.

soundness.notes: Playable for White; the line is a known try and is not refuted.

structure.notes: White e5/d4 against Black d5/f5 is a mutually blocked centre.

approach.notes: A named Vienna Gambit branch that strong players meet now and then; standard.

level.notes: Needs concrete knowledge of the Qf3 tactics and plans for the e4 knight.

sublines_that_differ.name: Spielmann 5.Qf3 Nc6
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nc3 Nf6 3. f4 d5 4. fxe5 Nxe4 5. Qf3 Nc6
sublines_that_differ.how: Black develops instead of ...f5 and the game changes character.

character.reason: Early queen sortie and an exposed e4-knight make this concrete and forcing.

gambit.reason: The f- and e-pawns have been traded, so material is level.

soundness.reason: Heyde is a known, playable try and not considered refuted.

structure.reason: White e5/d4 faces Black d5/f5 in a mutually blocked centre.

approach.reason: The Vienna Gambit is a respectable choice at all levels.

level.reason: It needs concrete tactics but is not a deep theoretical branch.

plans.reason: White develops the queen early to f3 and has to keep her safe on that square.
